memories.content: [Context Note] Similar tasks have benefited from a localization-first approach, using anatomical landmarks to disambiguate laterality before committing to a side-specific answer. metadata.original_query:
Which finding is in this chest X-ray?
Options: {"A": "surgical instruments in the right abdomen", "B": "surgical instruments in the left abdomen"}
metadata.retrieval_focus: Localizing and distinguishing left versus right anatomical regions in medical imaging, and identifying foreign objects such as surgical instruments by their appearance and position.
